evidence: Scoped source review of quality row 30 found meaningful successful controls for the negative outcomes. All task-relative citations below refer to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r1/task/. The current policy permits shared observed facts rather than duplicated scenarios (qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:13,19); functional/prompt.md:25,100 explicitly requires successful controls and disallows credit from a never-working feature or sibling verdict. The individual descriptors incorporate their named protocols. Working completed handlers precede Stop (functional/prompt.md:146-149; judge.toml:49), and actual completed content precedes retention (judge.toml:56). Pending cancellation first runs the same four-second callback to its delayed log/error, then establishes genuinely pending trials (prompt.md:168-180; judge.toml:63,70,462). Own-document execution precedes origin isolation (prompt.md:188-198). Network refusal requires successful matching fetch and image transport on a clean control plus supported snippet execution, with delivery counts and separate negative runs (prompt.md:204-210; judge.toml:91). Unsupported-family refusal has a real supported-code control and last-good baseline (prompt.md:216-236). Deadline checks first compute finite braced/unbraced/Promise loop values and complete short nested callbacks (prompt.md:242-267,451-459; judge.toml:140,364). Rollbacks use positively completed recorded renders, including entered input state (prompt.md:273-355). Clear acts on an actually populated console (prompt.md:381-383). Auto-run suppression first observes automatic execution and subsequently runs the same pending code manually; queue replacement additionally proves fresh automatic execution after switching documents (prompt.md:394-403; judge.toml:280,287,490,497). Text-only saving has successful monitor writes and final matching request execution (prompt.md:421-423). Stale Save uses successful same-record current writes in both role orders, actual dirty editors and unchanged fresh readback (prompt.md:439-444). History inspection follows actual saved revisions and a working Run/console; restore retries follow a captured successful restore, and stale restore follows real restore/save controls (prompt.md:465-472). Races require accepted control operations and exactly one successful winner, not two refusals (prompt.md:476-479). Restart preservation compares populated prior records/history and a previously successful restore (prompt.md:429-433). Gates require authored execution and a successful new Save/fresh-context read, rather than absence checks (gates/render/judge.toml:25; gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-29). Polish and Visual require rendered/reached surfaces, with no independent absence-only enforcement award. Adversarial reasoning: an otherwise live manual runner with dead timers, inert Auto-run, a never-populated console, or a backend rejecting every restore cannot receive their corresponding cancellation/idle/clear/restore-refusal credit because the required controls fail. A conforming alternative that freezes a stopped preview as static content, proactively prevents a stale UI submission, uses caught network errors, or preserves a last-good overlay remains expressly accepted; no live post-Stop handler or particular refusal status is imposed. Supporting runtime-results.json (SHA256 da795b0a7c722dcd01003b8f7debdb0616fec88f532386d0410ba3a717ab1276) records cancel-A-delayed and cancel-A-error before supersession, finite values 3/4/3 before loop timeouts, nested-control-done before the shared deadline, text/image delivery baseline 2 with both refused runs still at 2, and initial automatic execution after 751.9 ms before 3000-ms off-state observations. history-results.json (SHA256 6af53ad01e0cff5f332417cb8279006fc02c7eed9c457fe99bea91e47c666f84) records a successful restore to revision 4, same-result retries, a later successful revision 5 and a real stale conflict. All 21 index artifact hashes match. Proof-input hashes match the frozen server.js, app.tsx, runtime.ts and runner.html; functional prompt/judge hashes have changed, as the index discloses. These logs support control feasibility only. No new runtime trial, configured judge, private deterministic suite, Oracle/model score or portal pass is claimed; broader required measurement gaps are not waived by this scoped Pass.
